The same as Di Stéfano and Quini and one less than the legendary Telmo Zarra, six. He arrived from Mexico to sign for Atlético de Madrid where he scored 54 goals in 111 games and won his first Pichichi trophy. In 1985 he signed for Real Madrid, where he achieved his greatest collective and individual successes. He won five consecutive Leagues, a Copa del Rey, three Spanish Super Cups and a UEFA Cup. He also won four more trophies for the championship's top scorer. His bicycle kick goal against Logronés, his famous somersaults every time he celebrated a goal or the fact of being able to score 38 goals in a season, all with the first touch, were some of the images and feats that Hugo Sanchez left us and that will always be part of the historical memory of LaLiga

programme.title: 30 for 30: Pony Excess
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

Africa's Hunters: The Leopard Who Changed Her Spots (S3 E4). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2018. S3, Ep4
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: JAV. Год: 2018. S3, Ep4 «Africa's Hunters»…Zambia's extraordinary Luangwa Valley is the perfect hunting ground for some of Africa's most iconic predators. Prides of lions, packs of wild dogs, clans of hyenas and solitary leopards vie for the upper hand in a land where the dry season brings prey to their doorstepsLarge carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's HuntersDirector: Hannah Hoare

programme.title: Africa's Hunters: Deadly Rivals (S3 E5). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2018. S3, Ep5
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: JAV. Год: 2018. S3, Ep5 «Africa's Hunters»…Enter the world of a wild dog pack whose bountiful hunting grounds are threatened when a clan of spotted hyenas moves in nearby. The vulnerable pups start to go hungry as the scavenging rivals steal their food and eventually raid their denLarge carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's HuntersDirector: Hannah Hoare

programme.title: Super Senses: The Secret Power of Animals: Sight (S1 E3). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2014. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2014 г. Год: 2014. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2014. S1, Ep3 «Super Senses: The Secret Power of Animals»…Our human senses are pretty incredible – but we only see, hear and smell a tiny fraction of what's out there. There is a hidden world that animals across the globe can experience. In this episode explore the extraordinary sense of sight in the animal world. We travel through the colours of the rainbow, across the spectrum of light our eyes can see – and beyond. Presenters Helen Czerski and Patrick Aryee reveal how caribou use UV light to avoid wolves, they discover how seeing in slow motion lets dragonflies make a kill in the blink of a human eye, and they show how one animal can see in pitch dark – without using its eyesIncredible three-part documentary series in which hosts, biologist Patrick Aryee and physicist Helen Czerski, explore the extraordinary world of animal senses, doing various experiments and demonstrations featuring a variety of species. Human senses are pretty amazing, but humans can only see, hear and smell a tiny fraction of what's out there- this series will reveal how animals detect things beyond the limits of our perception. Each episode explores a extraordinary sense in the animal world- sight, sound and scentDirector: Kirstine Davidson

Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. programme.title: HOLY MARVELS WITH DENNIS QUAID S2 EP14

programme.desc: Từ kho báu vô giá được tìm thấy bên trong một thành phố bị mất tích cho đến bản thảo cổ ẩn sau bức tường, chúng ta khám phá những bí mật bị mất sâu bên trong những căn phòng vô hình khác nhau, như đường hầm, hang động hay thậm chí là nơi chôn cất.

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S5 EP05
programme.desc: Hình ảnh đầy ám ảnh của Tấm vải liệm Turin đã làm say đắm hàng triệu người trên thế giới. Nhưng chính xác thì chúng ta đang thấy cái gì và nó diễn ra như thế nào?

programme.title: TESTIMONIES OF WAR: WW2 REMEMBERED IN JAPAN
programme.desc: Câu chuyện về 'Cuộc chiến 15 năm' của Nhật Bản, tập trung vào thường dân Nhật Bản sống trên đất liền. Bộ phim tài liệu này theo dõi sự trỗi dậy nhanh chóng của đế chế cho đến những ngày cuối cùng đầy tàn khốc.

programme.title: SPECIAL FORCES S1 EP03
programme.desc: Khóa huấn luyện trinh sát thủy quân lục chiến của Thái Lan là một trong những khóa huấn luyện khắc nghiệt nhất trên thế giới. Từ việc uống máu rắn hổ mang đến bài kiểm tra bơi đêm chết người, chúng tôi tiết lộ những gì cần thiết để tạo nên đẳng cấp của Trinh sát biển Thái Lan.

programme.title: THE BERMUDA TRIANGLE: INTO CURSED WATERS S2 EP12
programme.desc: Nhóm tiết lộ những bí ẩn lớn nhất của Tam giác quỷ Bermuda: những con tàu và máy bay biến mất khó hiểu nhất cũng như các thế lực kỳ lạ và mạnh mẽ được cho là đứng sau danh tiếng chết chóc của Tam giác.

programme.title: SWAMP PEOPLE S14 EP12
programme.desc: Một đợt không khí lạnh có nguy cơ đóng băng mùa cá sấu. Troy tìm kiếm vùng nước ấm để cứu thế giới. Don pha một loại nước ép đặc biệt để thu hút những con cá sấu lớn. Joey và Zak đặt cược mọi thứ vào một loạt cửa xả lũ đang mở.
